title: Yellow leaves
cause: Overwatering, poor drainage or nutrient problems
solution: Check soil moisture and drainage before watering again
prevention: Use a pot with drainage holes and check soil before watering.

title: Brown leaf tips
symptom: Leaf tips become brown and dry
cause: Dry air, salt buildup or irregular watering
solution: Trim dry tips and review watering and fertilizer use
prevention: Water consistently and avoid excess fertilizer.

title: Wilting
cause: Dry soil, waterlogged roots or heat stress
solution: Check soil first; water if dry and improve drainage if soggy

title: Root rot
symptom: Roots are dark, soft or smell rotten
solution: Remove rotten roots and repot in fresh, well-draining mix

title: Underwatering
solution: Water thoroughly when appropriate and let excess drain

title: Overwatering
solution: Pause watering until soil reaches the right moisture level

title: Waterlogged soil
solution: Empty standing water and check drainage holes
prevention: Use suitable soil and a pot with drainage.

title: Dry, compacted soil
cause: Soil has become hydrophobic or compacted
solution: Rewet slowly in stages and loosen the surface gently

title: Foul-smelling soil
solution: Inspect roots and replace rotten material if needed

title: Leaf drop
cause: Stress, temperature changes or watering problems
solution: Check recent changes, light and soil moisture

title: Slow growth
cause: Low light, poor nutrition or seasonal dormancy
solution: Check light and the plant’s seasonal needs

title: Leggy stems
symptom: Long stems with large gaps between leaves
solution: Move gradually to brighter suitable light

title: Pale leaves
symptom: Leaves lose their usual green colour
solution: Check light and soil before adding fertilizer
prevention: Use balanced nutrition and suitable light.

title: Leaf scorch
cause: Strong sun, heat or fertilizer salts
solution: Move from harsh sun and review recent feeding
prevention: Acclimate plants gradually to stronger light.

title: Cold damage
symptom: Leaves turn black or limp after cold
solution: Move to a suitable warmer location

title: Heat stress
cause: High temperature and rapid water loss
solution: Provide shade and check soil moisture

title: Curling leaves
solution: Inspect leaf undersides and check soil moisture

title: White powdery coating
solution: Remove badly affected leaves and improve airflow

title: Downy mildew
symptom: Yellow patches and growth under leaves
solution: Remove affected foliage and seek plant-specific treatment advice
prevention: Improve airflow and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.

title: Black leaf spots
solution: Remove affected leaves and avoid splashing between plants
prevention: Use clean tools and improve airflow.

title: Rust disease
solution: Remove infected leaves and isolate if spreading

title: Leaf blight
solution: Remove affected tissue and check watering and airflow

title: Bacterial leaf spot
solution: Isolate plant and remove affected leaves with clean tools

title: Mosaic pattern
symptom: Irregular light and dark green patches
cause: Possible viral disease or pest damage
solution: Isolate plant and inspect for pests; seek diagnosis

title: Damping off
cause: Seedling disease favoured by wet conditions
solution: Remove collapsed seedlings and improve drainage
prevention: Use clean seed-starting mix and avoid overwatering.

title: Stem canker
solution: Remove affected parts if appropriate and seek diagnosis
prevention: Keep tools clean and avoid stem injuries.

title: Sooty mold
solution: Clean leaves gently and control honeydew-producing insects
prevention: Inspect for aphids, scale and whiteflies.

title: Aphids
symptom: Small insects cluster on soft shoots
solution: Rinse insects off or use a suitable labeled insecticidal soap

title: Spider mites
solution: Rinse leaf undersides and use a suitable labeled treatment if needed
prevention: Inspect undersides and avoid excessive dryness.

title: Mealybugs
solution: Remove visible insects and use an appropriate labeled treatment
prevention: Check leaf joints and new plants.

title: Scale insects
symptom: Small hard bumps on stems or leaves
solution: Remove carefully and use a suitable labeled treatment if needed

title: Whiteflies
symptom: Tiny white insects fly up when disturbed
solution: Rinse foliage and use suitable sticky traps or labeled treatment

title: Fungus gnats
cause: Moist potting mix and organic matter
solution: Let surface dry appropriately and use yellow sticky traps

title: Thrips
symptom: Silvery streaks and tiny dark specks
solution: Isolate plant and use an appropriate labeled treatment
prevention: Inspect new plants and flower buds.

title: Caterpillar damage
solution: Inspect leaves and remove caterpillars where practical

title: Slugs and snails
solution: Remove pests and reduce damp hiding places

title: Leaf miners
solution: Remove badly affected leaves and identify the pest

title: Ants on plants
solution: Check for aphids, scale or mealybugs and address them

title: Root-knot nematodes
symptom: Swollen root galls and weak growth
solution: Confirm diagnosis and replace contaminated medium when appropriate
prevention: Use clean soil and healthy planting material.

title: Bird damage
symptom: Seedlings pulled up or fruit pecked
solution: Use suitable protective netting or covers

title: Rodent damage
solution: Protect pots and remove food sources safely

title: Pest eggs
symptom: Clusters of tiny eggs on leaves
solution: Identify eggs before removing; some may be beneficial insects

title: Nitrogen deficiency
symptom: Older leaves yellow and growth slows
solution: Check soil and use suitable fertilizer as directed if needed

title: Iron deficiency
symptom: Young leaves yellow between green veins
cause: Iron unavailable to roots, sometimes due to high pH
solution: Check pH and growing conditions before adding iron

title: Magnesium deficiency
solution: Confirm the issue before applying a suitable supplement

title: Potassium deficiency
cause: Low potassium or root uptake problems
solution: Check nutrition and roots; fertilize appropriately if needed

title: Phosphorus deficiency
symptom: Slow growth and unusual dark foliage
cause: Possible phosphorus deficiency or cold roots
solution: Check soil and temperature before fertilizing

title: Calcium-related disorders
symptom: Distorted new leaves or fruit-end rot
cause: Calcium delivery problems or irregular water supply
solution: Keep moisture consistent and check growing conditions
prevention: Avoid irregular watering and excess salts.

title: Overfertilizing
symptom: Brown tips or crust on soil
solution: Pause feeding and flush salts if drainage is good

title: Fertilizer burn
solution: Flush soil carefully if the pot drains freely

title: High soil pH
cause: Nutrients may be unavailable at high pH
solution: Test growing medium and adjust appropriately
prevention: Choose a medium suitable for the species.

title: Salt buildup
symptom: White crust on soil or pot rim
cause: Mineral salts from fertilizer or water
solution: Flush with suitable water if drainage is good
prevention: Feed moderately and monitor water quality.

title: No flowers
cause: Insufficient light, immature plant or excess nitrogen
solution: Check species-specific flowering requirements and light
prevention: Provide appropriate light and seasonal care.

title: Flowers falling
cause: Heat, inconsistent watering or poor pollination
solution: Stabilize watering and temperature

title: Bud drop
cause: Stress, dry air or irregular watering
solution: Check moisture, light and temperature

title: Poor fruit set
symptom: Flowers form but little fruit develops
solution: Check pollination needs and local growing conditions

title: Fruit dropping
cause: Water stress, heat or natural thinning
solution: Maintain even moisture and check plant health

title: Blossom-end rot
symptom: Dark sunken patch at fruit blossom end
cause: Calcium transport disruption often linked to irregular moisture
solution: Remove affected fruit and maintain consistent moisture

title: Fruit cracking
cause: Rapid water uptake after dry conditions
solution: Harvest ripe fruit and stabilize watering

title: Sunscald on fruit
symptom: Pale or papery patches on exposed fruit
solution: Remove severely damaged fruit and protect exposed fruit

title: Poor pollination
cause: Low pollinator activity or lack of compatible pollen
solution: Check whether hand pollination suits the species

title: Small fruit
cause: Low light, nutrient imbalance or heavy fruit load
solution: Check light, nutrition and the plant’s fruiting needs

title: Misshapen fruit
cause: Incomplete pollination, temperature stress or pests
solution: Inspect fruit and flowers and review growing conditions
prevention: Maintain consistent care and pollinator access.

title: Fruit rotting
solution: Remove rotten fruit and improve airflow
prevention: Harvest carefully and avoid excess moisture.

title: Flower buds fail to open
solution: Inspect buds and check temperature and moisture

title: Rootbound plant
symptom: Roots circle tightly inside the pot
solution: Repot into a slightly larger container if appropriate

title: Roots growing from drainage holes
solution: Check root density and repot if crowded

title: Leaning plant
solution: Rotate pot gradually and provide support if needed

title: Broken stem
solution: Make a clean cut where appropriate and support remaining growth
prevention: Handle carefully and support heavy stems.

title: Girdling roots
symptom: Roots circle and constrict stem base
cause: Root growth pattern or tight container
solution: Seek careful root correction during repotting

title: Poor drainage
symptom: Water remains in the saucer or pot
solution: Clear drainage holes and empty the saucer

title: Pot too large
symptom: Growing medium stays wet too long
cause: Container volume exceeds root system needs
solution: Consider an appropriately sized pot and suitable mix

title: Pot too small
symptom: Plant dries rapidly and roots crowd
cause: Container too small for root system
solution: Repot when roots are crowded

title: Mold on soil surface
symptom: White fuzzy growth on potting mix
cause: Persistently damp surface and organic material
solution: Remove surface growth and let the top layer dry appropriately

title: Algae on soil
cause: Frequent moisture and light on soil
solution: Remove film and adjust watering surface conditions
prevention: Avoid keeping the surface constantly wet.

title: Water pools on soil
symptom: Water sits on top instead of soaking in
solution: Loosen surface gently and assess whether repotting is needed

title: Water drains too quickly
symptom: Water runs straight through the pot
solution: Check whether soil absorbs water evenly and rewet gradually

title: Dusty leaves
solution: Wipe gently with a damp soft cloth if suitable

title: Sticky leaves
solution: Inspect and control aphids, scale or whiteflies

title: Silvery streaks
solution: Inspect for insects and isolate if necessary
prevention: Check new plants before bringing them home.

title: Mottled leaves
cause: Natural variegation, pests or possible virus
solution: Compare healthy growth and inspect for pests
prevention: Use clean tools and control pests.

title: Transparent leaves
cause: Cold damage, excess moisture or injury
solution: Remove damaged leaves and correct the cause

title: Red or purple leaves
symptom: Leaves develop red or purple tones
cause: Natural colouring, cold stress or nutrient issues
solution: Check species traits and recent environmental changes

title: White bleached leaves
solution: Move away from harsh sun and inspect the leaf surface

title: Yellow leaf edges
solution: Review watering, drainage and fertilizer use
prevention: Avoid excess fertilizer and irregular watering.

title: Tiny leaves
symptom: New leaves are smaller than usual
cause: Low light, root stress or insufficient nutrition
solution: Check light, roots and growing conditions

title: No new leaves
cause: Dormancy, low light or root stress
solution: Check season, light and root health

title: Excessive soft growth
solution: Reduce excessive feeding and improve light

title: Buds eaten
symptom: Flower buds have holes or missing tissue
solution: Inspect buds and identify the cause before treatment
prevention: Monitor buds and use suitable protection.

title: Herbs taste weak
symptom: Herb leaves have little aroma or flavour
cause: Low light, old growth or unsuitable harvest timing
solution: Provide appropriate light and harvest correctly

title: Mint spreading too much
symptom: Mint sends runners beyond its area
solution: Grow mint in a container or trim runners

title: Seedlings are leggy
solution: Provide brighter suitable light and avoid overheating

title: Seeds fail to germinate
cause: Old seeds, wrong depth, temperature or moisture
solution: Check seed age and species-specific sowing instructions
prevention: Use fresh seed and suitable conditions.

title: Seedlings turn yellow
cause: Excess water, low light or depleted seed-starting mix
solution: Improve light and check moisture and nutrition

title: Transplant shock
solution: Provide gentle suitable light and stable moisture
prevention: Handle roots carefully and acclimate gradually.

title: Plant not recovering
cause: Original cause may remain or diagnosis may be wrong
solution: Recheck symptoms, roots, pests and environmental conditions
prevention: Change one care factor at a time and monitor.

title: Poor indoor flowering
cause: Insufficient light or missing seasonal cues
solution: Check the plant’s light and seasonal requirements
prevention: Choose a suitable location and follow species care.

title: Leaves wet for too long
cause: Poor airflow or frequent overhead watering
solution: Improve airflow and water at soil level when suitable

title: Damaged roots after repotting
solution: Reduce stress and maintain appropriate moisture

title: Pest recurrence
cause: Eggs remain or nearby plants are infested
solution: Repeat inspection and treatment according to product label
prevention: Check nearby plants and follow treatment directions.
